constraints.u13Placeholder: e.g. Keep all content strictly age-appropriate for teenagers. No violence, no romantic content, no horror themes.

constraints.u13pLabel: Constraint for users aged 13-17, with parental consent (U13p)

about.oneLiner: These text adventures were created with ChatGameLab: made by their creators, without programming, told live by an AI.
about.details: Their makers describe the world, the characters and the rules in their own words. While you play, an AI keeps telling the story from there: it reacts to whatever you type and invents matching pictures — so no two rounds play out the same way. Building one yourself quickly shows how strongly your own instructions shape the result, and where an AI reaches its limits. That is the whole point: not having AI explained to you, but trying it out.
